summary: A single 19 m Empyrean Stone Tower on a low ridge at the edge of the Falamar Hills, open grassland around.

shots.standingOrder: Fly east at 6 m/s 22 m south of the Empyrean Stone Tower and 9 m above its base, yawing to keep it centred; stay 14 m from its south wall.
shots.notes: The lone 19 m Empyrean Stone Tower on the edge of the Falamar Hills whips past at the closest approach (t 4.5 s, yaw rate about 0.27 rad/s); the south sun lights the face.
